channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: AMD, Micron and Nvidia extend losses as chip stocks get clobbered
item.description: Semiconductor stocks fell on Tuesday, extending a rout in chipmakers after another weak session on Wall Street.

item.title: Apple plans to lease iPhones for $17.99 a month through partnership with Klarna
item.description: Apple is announcing an iPhone lease option weeks after raising iPad and Mac prices due to the global memory shortage.

item.title: Visa is cutting 7% of employees in efficiency push as AI reshapes work
item.description: Visa plans to cut about 7% of its workforce, or roughly 2,600 employees, as CEO Ryan McInerney seeks to streamline the payments giant.

item.title: Boeing posts wider loss than expected as Air Force One costs weigh on results
item.description: Boeing took a $280 million charge on its long-delayed Air Force One program.

item.title: Trump: New tariffs 'doing the same thing' as the ones struck down by Supreme Court
item.description: Trump dismissed fears that his tariffs could hurt the economy — especially as affordability concerns have become a key issue of the upcoming midterm elections.

item.title: BofA thinks ASML isn’t under threat from China, and that investors are overreacting
item.description: The bank said replacing the Dutch company's presence in China is a high hurdle.

item.title: Coca-Cola hikes full-year forecast. CEO tells CNBC the World Cup boosted its brands
item.description: Coca-Cola said demand for its drinks rose in every market in the second quarter, helped in part by the World Cup.

item.title: UPS expects third-quarter domestic revenue to be flat but CEO tells CNBC the company is through its 'bumps'
item.description: UPS beat Wall Street expectations and raised its full-year guidance in its second-quarter earnings report Tuesday.

item.title: Elevated energy prices, AI capex binge puts the Fed and Kevin Warsh in a tough spot
item.description: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh and many of his devotees have argued that some short-term price pain can be tolerated in anticipation of AI eventually suppressing inflation.

item.title: SpaceX stock-purchasing by Congress members fuels conflict concerns
item.description: Five of the Congress members serve on committees whose work touches SpaceX's federal contracts, defense programs, AI, telecommunications or securities markets.

item.title: Blurred front lines: Trump meets Zelenskyy as Ukraine, Iran wars collide
item.description: Trump and Zelenskyy meet as the U.S war against Iran and Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine have threatened to overlap in recent days.

item.title: Major quake hits southern Japan, workers missing after mall blast
item.description: A major earthquake rocked Japan's southern Kumamoto prefecture on Tuesday, knocking out power to thousands of homes and injuring at least ​50 people.

item.title: Amazon, Meta and Microsoft face skeptical investors this week after Google report sparked sell-off
item.description: Alphabet's free cash flow has turned negative, and the company lifted its capital spending forecast. Slower-growing cloud rivals report this week.

item.title: Iran hosts Hormuz calls with Saudi Arabia, Oman as Trump hails ‘good talks’
item.description: Talks over the Strait of Hormuz continue as Iran's foreign ministry discussed the strategically vital maritime passage with Saudi and Omani counterparts.

item.title: Tuesday's move in Intuitive Surgical is probably more than short covering. How to play it using options
Analysis: Kevin Warsh's Fed press conference will be revealing even without a rate hike
item.description: Warsh will reveal how he weighs energy shocks, AI-driven price pressure, the Fed's task forces and pressure from Trump.

item.title: New Republican ads slam Democrats opposed to Trump's tariffs
item.description: As the 2026 midterm elections approach, the National Republican Congressional Committee is knocking Democrats who have opposed President Donald Trump's tariffs.

item.title: Supreme Court approval hits record low as Republicans' support declines
item.description: The Trump administration saw some big losses at the Supreme Court in 2026 on issues involving tariffs, birthright citizenship and the Federal Reserve.

item.title: Lawmakers renew push to axe a lucrative tax loophole for crypto investors
item.description: Crypto investors have largely been exempt from the "wash sale" rules that apply to stocks and other traditional assets. Congress is trying to clamp down.

item.title: Meta, BlackRock partner on $14 billion El Paso data center
Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Tuesday
item.description: The downturn in chip stocks continues. Is the Nvidia selling at last overdone?

item.title: Student loan default is rising: 3 ways to start paying down your balance — even on a tight budget
item.description: You can put extra money toward your student loans by earning bank account bonuses, maximizing credit card rewards and negotiating down your monthly bills.

item.title: SpaceX has now lost the equivalent of a full Tesla in market capitalization
item.description: Elon Musk's space company has wiped off more than $1.2 trillion in market cap since hitting a high of $225.64 per share in June.

item.title: Trump says U.S. has sold more than $13 billion of Venezuela oil since Maduro's capture
item.description: President Donald Trump said Monday the U.S. has sold more than $13 billion of Venezuelan oil since taking control of the South American nation's energy exports.

item.title: J&J reaches sweeping talc deal that could end decade of litigation
item.description: Johnson & Johnson said Monday it would pay an estimated $5.5 billion to resolve lawsuits alleging its baby powder and other talc products ​cause ovarian cancer.

item.title: JetBlue overhauls fare options, from basic first to flexible economy. Here's what to know
item.description: JetBlue is doing away with its "Core" product and putting economy tickets under a new name.

item.title: Amazon seeks federal approval to launch 5,105 satellites for direct-to-device network
item.description: The proposed network will partly rely on assets from Globalstar, which Amazon announced plans to acquire in April for roughly $11.6 billion.

item.title: Microsoft touts cost-saving AI model for cybersecurity
item.description: Microsoft says that when integrated with OpenAI's GPT-5.4, its new cybersecurity model can beat Anthropic's new Mythos 5.

item.title: Wildfires burn nearly 300,000 acres in France and Spain as heat wave looms
item.description: Temperatures in France are expected to rise to 95 degrees Fahrenheit this week, as firefighters battle the ongoing wildfire, which has affected parts of Spain.

item.title: Nvidia and OpenAI in talks for up to $250 billion backstop to fund AI infrastructure plans
item.description: The backstop would let OpenAI raise debt for a data center campus in Pike County, Ohio, on the strength of Nvidia's credit.
